Game Overview

In Shark Killer, the core idea is straightforward: become the ocean's top predator in Shark Killer. Devour smaller fish to boost your strength and health while navigating vibrant, treacherous waters. Quick reflexes and strategic planning are crucial as you dodge larger threats and use power-ups to eliminate your sea rivals. Master the depths, survive, and conquer.
